description: This script, size_compare.sh, is a Bash script used for comparing the sizes of OpenWrt packages between local builds and upstream repositories. It reads configuration variables from environment and config files, fetches package index files over HTTP, and performs comparisons based on package sizes, reporting differences to help evaluate the storage impact of customizations.

methods.name: help
methods.description: Outputs usage instructions and help message extracted from comments starting with '###'.

methods.name: package_size
methods.description: Fetches and returns the size of a specified package either from local installed data or upstream build info depending on the configuration.

methods.name: compare_sizes
methods.description: Iterates over configured packages, finds their corresponding files, measures local and upstream sizes, compares them, and outputs size differences.
